description:
Relative expression of a wheat gene's A, B and D homoeologues per tissue/stage (Expression Atlas baseline
experiments), with the homoeologue expression balance category of each tissue: balanced, A/B/D dominant or
A/B/D suppressed, by distance to the ideal proportions (Ramirez-Gonzalez et al. 2018). Categories are given only
for 1:1:1 triads with summed TPM >= 0.5. experiment restricts to one accession.
name: wheat_homoeologue_expression
